description.value: Kicking Horse is a hike-in backcountry campground in E.C. Manning Park's Cascade Mountains, reachable only on foot more than 1 km from any road; a permit is required year-round and advance reservation is mandatory in peak summer season — inaccessible to a loaded touring bike.

No campground-specific amenity details (water, shelter, food storage, etc.) are broken out for Kicking Horse on the page — only park-wide permit/reservation logistics are described.

This is a backcountry campsite accessible only on foot (>1 km from any highway or park road); it is not directly accessible by bike unless riders are willing to hike their bikes.

enrichment_extras.notes: BC Parks general reservation/info line: 1-800-689-9025 (toll-free Canada/US). Backcountry permits required for all overnight stays; reservations for Kicking Horse must be made in advance through camping.bcparks.ca during peak season.
